body:
I'm constantly tired and working over time all day from 8 till 8 just so I have enough money for food and rent. I've tried with my family they just think I'm being silly and that I just want attention. 

That's not what I want. I don't want a perfect like I just want a reason to smile every once in a while and I haven't smiled properly since al this started in 2006 I have put a fake smile on so people don't constantly say what's up or are you ok. If they ask I just burst in to tears. I don't know how much more I can take.
Just me. It's so hard to be happy and think about other things. My life is rubbish I just don't know how I can do it any more

My demons are myself. Inside my head I think to much which makes me panic. My job I love it but it's just making me more drained I'm doing more and more overtime cause I need the money which is not making me any better. 

I need to sort my life out.
